notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Hardmode[/h1]
Was the zompizza too easy?
For those who are still hungry, “Hard Mode” is here.
In hard mode, it's harder to get a rating, there are more zombies, 
and your vehicle explodes when it takes damage!

In fact, this was the intended difficulty level of prototype.
Will you be able to escape this new fate?

[list]
[*] More field traps
[*] Changed some field objects
[*] Added fun chatting with villagers
[*] 2 new achievements
[/list]

We also lowered the price of the game a little bit.
